key_insight: Symmetric polyconvex neural networks (SPCNNs) guarantee symmetric polyconvexity by construction and universally approximate symmetric polyconvex energies without assuming isotropy.
engineering_relevance: SPCNNs provide a structure-preserving approach to small-strain constitutive modeling and approximation of lower bounds for relaxed nonconvex energies.
method: Combine convexity with the required monotonicity in a lifted space of minors.
Prove universal approximation and quantify the lifted network’s attainable affine pieces.
Derive reduced architectures for isotropic energies.
evidence_signal: Numerical examples demonstrate stress-based regression and approximation of the symmetric polyconvex envelope of a double-well potential.
watch_item: Symmetric polyconvexity is guaranteed, but fitted accuracy is assessed numerically; an envelope approximation should not be equated with the exact relaxed energy.
paper_title: Universal neural network approximation of symmetric polyconvex energies and envelopes
